propositions: One-time backfill of close_class for closed bugs lacking it using only structural signals: REVERT of STATUS/COMMITS event infers regression, plan-review BLOCK verdict infers plan_defect, gate_error_v1 ERROR record infers env_integration, otherwise undetermined.

Backfilled classifications are written to dedicated NDJSON file .rebar/backfill-close-class.ndjson with source=backfill_classified and confidence=classified to segregate them from authoritative close_class values.
Script skips bugs that already have state[close_class] set (authoritative value protection) and bugs already present in the artifact (idempotency by ticket_id).

REVERT signal requires target_event_type of STATUS or COMMITS (substantive revert), not COMMENT/LINK; plan-review BLOCK verdict must be read via all_review_results; gate_error_v1 requires raw event-file scan of sidecar streams since schema guards silently skip non-plan_review_result payloads.
Backfilled records carry is_authoritative(source)=False to distinguish them from authoritative structural series in the c085 registry.

Test suite asserts four signal classifications (regression, plan_defect, env_integration, undetermined), idempotence, authoritative-value non-overwrite, record metadata correctness, and substantive-revert filter.
